evals.prompt: 我有个 CocosCreator 的 Playable 项目，在 src/game/GameManager.ts 里有个 initScene 方法，调用了 this.loadAssets() 之后直接执行 this.startGame()，但是 startGame 里用到的资源有时候还没加载完就开始了，导致偶发性白屏。帮我修一下。
evals.expected_output: Agent should: 1) Read GameManager.ts first before proposing any fix, 2) Trace loadAssets and startGame call chain, 3) Identify root cause (async timing issue), 4) Present a fix plan with checklist before editing, 5) Not just add try-catch around startGame

assertions.description: Must Read the file before modifying
Root cause analysis should identify async timing issue
Should NOT propose try-catch as the fix (symptom patch)
Must output a verification table before claiming done

Must explain WHY the title shows 'New conversation' (answer the question)
